decisions: Minutes from October 22, 2025 board meeting approved unanimously.
Approved reallocation of $250,000 from contingency reserve to Q1 2026 marketing initiative; budget amendment due December 15, 2025.
Approved pursuit of expanded contract renewal (Scenario B) with Acme Corp, adding logistics consulting and ESG compliance advisory services.
Acme Corp contract renewal to be finalized by January 31, 2026, led by Margaret Holvan.
Dedicated account manager to be assigned to Acme Corp by December 10, 2025.
Approved technology infrastructure upgrade; RFP to be issued to minimum three vendors by December 20, 2025, with migration targeting Q2 2026.
Authorized creation of Director of Business Development role; recruitment to begin immediately with target start date of March 1, 2026, compensation band $140,000–$165,000 base plus incentives.
Approved engagement of external cybersecurity firm for penetration test and audit, budget up to $28,000, to be completed by December 31, 2025.
Approved professional liability insurance renewal with Kelton Assurance Group at $67,500 for FY2026.
